page.layout: One block of text, in one column. Running head at the top, page number at the top right. In the right margin, beside the second paragraph, a section marker "IX.".

main_text.p: rem per se claram ac perspicuam negan-tium: Sed hinc non sequitur quin Logon ex aliquo Æone eductum asseruerint; Nus emittit ex semetipso Sermonem seu Logon, inquit Tertullianus contra Valenti-num cap. 7. en immediatam Logi ex Nu emissionem, imò primam Æonum Tetradem, ut cæterorum principium ac causam ibidem repræsentat; Bythos & Sige, Nus & Veritas, prima quadriga defendit[?] Valentinianæ factionis, matrix & origo cunctorum. Ergo ex Sige educitur Logus,cùm ex primâ emittatur Tetrade, Irenæus pariter, mox enim dicebat, Valentinum definivisse ex prima dualitate Bythi & Si-ges, secundam emissam esse Nu videlicet & Aletheias; Ex hac autem quaternatio-ne, fructificari Logon & Zoen Anthropon & Ecclesiam; si igitur ex primâ illâ quaternatione fructificatur Logus, ut loquitur vetus Irenæi interpres, id est si illo quaternario editus est, negari non potest quin ex Sige educatur, quando Sige ad primam illius tetradis conjugationem pertinet.
IX.Quod observat Vindiciarum Auctor pag. 44. 45. Nun Monogenen sive unigenitum dictum esse, quòd ille solus ex Bytho & Sige natus est, cujuscúnque respectu id dicat Tertullianus, Dallæo non

page.notes: The blot near "defendit" makes the last letter doubtful; read as "defendit[?]". A small mark after "Tertullianus" is probably a stray stroke, not a reference, so it is not transcribed. The "IX." in the margin is a section number and is set as a note. The second paragraph breaks off at the foot of the page and continues on the next page.
